critical_code_review_comments: FeeBreakdown.computeFees isVisaFree detection now has a robust primary signal (country.no_visa) with a copy-based fallback — good improvement over iter-2. The fallback path '(govt===0 && category.name contains visa-free)' is still fragile if localisation leaks into category.name; safe to drop the fallback once all seeds expose no_visa explicitly.

LanguageSwitcher.jsx has no data-testid attributes on the trigger button or option buttons. For future testability add data-testid="language-switcher-button" on the trigger and data-testid="language-option-{code}" on each option. Today tests have to fall back on aria-label + native-text matching.

Applicants state is still duplicated between VisaDetail (useState mirror via onApplicantsChange) and FeeBreakdown (source of truth). Working today but fragile — consider lifting to VisaDetail (carry-over from iter-2).

Hero subheading is not yet translated (still English 'Bridging dreams, connecting continents…' across all languages). Not in the round-4 spec's listed keys, but likely to be flagged by a reviewer since hero.sub is visibly untranslated next to the localised headline.

visa-free-note copy is hard-coded English inside FeeBreakdown.jsx; when the user switches to Hindi/Telugu/Tamil/Kannada/Bengali the green banner still says 'Visa-free for Indians. No government fee — you pay only for our concierge service…'. Suggest routing this string through t() with a new i18n key (e.g., fee.visaFreeNote).
